knownExemptions.reason: CoreMedia defines an omitted FullRangeVideo extension as false for YCbCr-based compressed formats, so ProRes limited range uses the platform default.
The ProRes matrix value comes from each compressed frame header; CoreMedia source format descriptions omit this per-frame value from the stream-level format description.
CoreMedia's H.264 parameter-set constructor materializes the documented limited-range default when the SPS omits a range declaration.
